```yaml
name: Security Scan

# v4.2.2
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 9 * * 1' # Runs every Monday at 9:00 JST

jobs:
  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run security scan
        id: security-scan
        run: npm run security-scan

      - name: Send email notification
        if: ${{ success() }}
        run: echo "::set-output name=email_body::${{ steps.security-scan.outputs.email_body }}"
        env:
          RESEND_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RESEND_API_KEY }}
          RESEND_FROM_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL }}
          SECURITY_SCAN_RECIPIENT: ${{ secrets.SECURITY_SCAN_RECIPIENT }}

      - name: Email results
        if: ${{ success() }}
        run: |
          curl -s --request POST \
            --url https://api.resend.com/emails \
            --header "Authorization: Bearer $RESEND_API_KEY" \
            --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
            --data '{
              "from": "$RESEND_FROM_EMAIL",
              "to": ["$SECURITY_SCAN_RECIPIENT"],
              "subject": "Security Scan Results - $(date +%Y-%m-%d)",
              "text": "${{ steps.security-scan.outputs.email_body }}"
            }'
        env:
          RESEND_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RESEND_API_KEY }}
          RESEND_FROM_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL }}
          SECURITY_SCAN_RECIPIENT: ${{ secrets.SECURITY_SCAN_RECIPIENT }}
```

This GitHub Actions workflow performs a security scan on `.toon` files using the OpenRouter API and sends email notifications via Resend. The workflow runs weekly on Mondays at 9:00 JST and includes steps for checking out the repository, setting up Node.js, installing dependencies, running the security scan, and sending email notifications. The email contains the results of the security scan in Markdown format.
